description: Validates a proposed workflow answer against Hive's typed task-output and evidence-receipt contract before it is shown to the user. It checks the selected route id, ordered route-only calls, conditional fallback use, the four-call route budget, claim-to-receipt citations, canonical phase coverage, and internal receipt consistency. It cannot authenticate invented receipts or turn SHA-256 self-checks into signatures, so every call entry must be copied exactly from the server-minted _hive block returned by that execution.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data (default) or 'markdown' for human-readable text.

result.description: The proposed task result envelope. Each receipt.calls entry must be copied exactly from a material call's _hive object.

task_toolset_id.description: Canonical task toolset id returned by search_tools.

name: validate_task_result

cache_age_ms.description: Milliseconds since Hive first observed the response. Zero means newly retrieved from the provider, not that the provider's underlying datum is current.

cause.description: Errors only: what actually happened, written for the model.

credit_cost.description: Static credit price of this tool: 0 for discovery tools and free writes, 1 for everything else. Present when the calling lane bills.

credits_remaining.description: Balance after this call: keyed credits, or keyless calls left today. null for unlimited plans; absent when the lane has no notion.

credits_used.description: Credits actually debited for this call: 0 when validation or a gate stopped it, credit_cost once the provider was reached.

doc_url.description: Docs anchor for the error code (errors only).

fallback_used.description: Present and true when a task-route fallback tool produced this response after the primary returned failing/missing_key. provider/tool name the actual executed source.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 self-check of canonical JSON arguments. It is not a server signature.

next_action.description: Errors only: the one useful next step. Follow it instead of retrying the same call unchanged.

observed_at.description: When Hive first observed this response. On a cache hit this is the original cache-population time; it is not necessarily the upstream datum's event time.

origin_source.description: Original upstream tier. Preserved as fallback when a fallback-tier response is later served from cache.

receipt_id.description: Unique runtime receipt for this Hive tool call. Include it when reporting or debugging the evidence.

result_digest.description: SHA-256 self-check of the canonical returned payload after Hive result normalization and before the top-level _hive receipt is attached.

sanitized.description: Present and true when instruction-shaped provider text was neutralized before reaching agent context.

title: Validate Task Result
